acceptanceCriteria: A spec amendment to learned-trace-admission-v0 defines the observation record, its support count, citation pinning and the staleness rule, with requirement IDs.
Frozen cases cover consolidation of agreeing rows, a stale observation after a cited blob changes, and an observation never outranking project-owned authority.
The skill-export projection either consumes observations or explicitly excludes them, stated in the spec.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 from a review of vectorize-io/hindsight (MIT agent-memory system; README reviewed via summary, paper arXiv 2512.12818 and code not read). Hindsight consolidates related facts into 'observations' that keep exact quotes, a proof count and supporting evidence, and refines rather than overwrites them. Corvint analog: group admitted learned-trace rows that support the same route into one observation carrying its support count and the pinned blob citations of every supporting row; mark it stale (not authoritative) when any cited blob changes at the bound revision. No LLM extraction, no new mutable store; admission, secret screening and the LTA held-out gate still govern, and project authority still outranks it (invariant 3).
title: learning: consolidate repeated admitted traces into pinned, support-counted observations that go stale when cited blobs change
